ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Systems of Display. This seminar will examine the material culture of World's Fairs and International Exhibitions; we will analyze the design of exposition grounds and buildings, as well as the objects and peoples displayed, the events staged, and the viewing experiences constructed. In the 19th century, Fairs promoted the assumed superiority of Western cultur -- what systems of display constructed and embedded this viewing position? In various ways, contemporary international art biennials, which find themselves located at the intersection of globalism, consumerism and tourism, continue the tradition of the World's Fair. As such, this seminar will also address the technologies of display (and ideological underpinnings) at work in these events, as well as 20th century exhibitions such as MoMA's INFORMATION.
